messages:
alice_support: FYI customer Acme Search reports intermittent 400 from /v1/rerank since yesterday. They say request accepted by our gateway but parser later throws "Invalid candidate scores: expected number". Pasting sanitized request they provided below.
alice_support: RAW_BODY (sanitized):
Content-Type: application/json; charset=ISO-8859-1
{
  "query": "How do I refund an order?",
  "candidates": [
    {"id": "c1", "text": "refund policy overview", "score": "0.92,0.1"},
    {"id": "c2", "text": "steps to refund", "score": "0.85"}
  ],
  "meta": { "source": "acme-search", "items": [{"nested": true}] }
}

alice_support: They also say their SDK returns a 400 with parser message: "unexpected token ',' in numeric field at byte 482". Sentry event: https://sentry.redwood/example/ISSUE-3344 (sanitized)

ben_engineering: @alice_support thanks. Two quick Qs: do we have correlation_id/request id from the gateway logs? and can we see the exact bytes (hex) around the error? If header is ISO-8859-1 and they include control bytes it can confuse our JSON parser.

alice_support: Gateway logs: request_id=rid_0a1b2c3d. Parser stderr: "json_parse_error: invalid_number at offset 481 (char 0x1A)". Customer says their mobile client sends payload via legacy internal serializer. I asked them to dump raw bytes; they pasted this snippet (hex):

... 7b 22 63 61 6e 64 69 64 61 74 65 73 22 3a 20 5b 7b 22 69 64 22 3a 22 63 31 22 2c 20 22 74 65 78 74 22 3a 22 72 65 66 75 6e 64 20 70 6f 6c 69 63 79 22 2c 20 22 73 63 6f 72 65 22 3a 22 30 2e 39 32 2c 30 2e 31 22 7d ...

ben_engineering: That hex shows the score field is a CSV string ("0.92,0.1") not a number or array. Our rerank schema expects candidates[].score to be a number if present (we compute scores otherwise). Also control char 0x1A could be stray from Windows/legacy serializer. Both will break strict parser. I can repro locally.

charlie_ml: Quick context: we compute model-based scores during rerank and ignore provided "score" normally, but earlier we allowed an optional "score" number for hybrid fusion. Recent schema tightening (PR #4120) made the validator strict: score must be a single number, not string/CSV. The error path comes from our fast_json parser which rejects non-numeric tokens in number fields.

charlie_ml: Short-term options:
- Ask customer to send scores as numbers or as an array under a different key, e.g. "prior_scores": [0.92, 0.1].
- Add tolerant parsing for legacy CSV-in-string for a few days behind a feature-flag.
- Strip control characters from incoming payloads at gateway (danger: may mask corruption).

alice_support: Customer insists they need to pass per-candidate weights as CSV string because their SDK serializes that way. They want an ETA for a fix. Can we do tolerant parse quickly? :eyes:

ben_engineering: I can push a small gateway sanitizer that, before handing body to parser, checks for candidates[*].score as string containing commas and attempts to parse into number or array. I'll add guarded logic and a config toggle. Rough patch + tests ~2-3 hours. If we deploy to prod edge tomorrow morning we can give them a temporary workaround.

charlie_ml: If we add tolerant parsing, ensure we only accept: single-number string ("0.85") -> number, or csv string where there is exactly one value -> number, or csv with multiple values -> reject or map to "prior_scores" array. Also log telemetry so we can later remove support. I'll prepare validation changes and tests.

ben_engineering: Repro script I used (node fetch) — their mobile SDK was doing this accidentally (stringify of an array):
```js
fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {'Content-Type':'application/json; charset=ISO-8859-1'},
  body: JSON.stringify({ query: 'x', candidates: [{id:'c1', text:'a', score: [0.92,0.1]] }})
})
```
Note: JSON.stringify on malformed objects or circular refs can produce odd results.

alice_support: Linking internal ticket: https://redwood/issue/ENG-7881. Customer message (dave_acme): "we need a fix today, this breaks >50% of calls". I asked for sanitized sample and they sent the one above.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: new deploy queued: gateway-sanitizer-featureflag branch -> staging at 2024-05-14T03:20Z

ben_engineering: Going to stage the patch now. I'll post back with staging logs and a temp curl for the customer to test.

dave_acme: any updates? our devs are blocked.

alice_support: pinged devs, staging deploy in progress. ETA ~3h for customer-facing workaround. Will follow up with exact curl they can try to validate once staged. :thumbsup:
